context: Two friends complain about leaving things turned on at home
purpose: Teach: いかにも/網/打っ/満ち/回避/っぱなし/じっと/マル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねえ聞いてよ、今朝もエアコンつけっぱなしで出ちゃったの…
lines.en: Hey listen, this morning I left the AC running again when I went out…
lines.style: Soft confessional tone, slightly embarrassed, drawn-out vowels with a sigh.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: わかる、私なんてこの三か月、ストーブつけっぱなしの日が半分くらいあるよ。
lines.en: I get it, for the past three months I've had the stove left on about half the days.
lines.style: Warm, casual barista voice, light self-deprecating laugh between phrases.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 電気代、いかにも高そうな請求書がポストに届いてて、じっと見つめちゃった。
lines.en: An obviously expensive-looking bill arrived in the mailbox, and I just stared at it.
lines.style: Dreamy, melancholic delivery with theatrical pauses on key words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 請求書に赤マルで囲まれた数字見ると、心臓に悪いよね、ほんと負荷すごい。
lines.en: Seeing the number circled in red on the bill is bad for your heart, real strain honestly.
lines.style: Friendly chuckle, conspiratorial tone like sharing a secret over coffee.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うちなんて網戸まで開けっぱなしで、部屋の中、虫で満ち満ちだったの…
lines.en: At my place even the screen door was left open, and the room was packed full of bugs…
lines.style: Whispery horror, trailing off with a shudder at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それは回避したかったやつやん。もう何もできへんって感じ?
lines.en: That's the kind of thing you really wanted to avoid. Feels like there's nothing you can do?
lines.style: Casual sympathetic teasing, slight Kansai lilt creeping in playfully.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: もう諦めて、虫取り網持って戦ったよ…完全に手遅れだったけど。
lines.en: I gave up and grabbed a bug-catching net to fight…but it was completely too late.
lines.style: Defeated whisper rising to a small laugh, romantic resignation in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 次から家出る前、スマホのリストにマル打ってから鍵閉めよ?約束ね。
lines.en: From now on, check off the list on your phone before locking up, okay? Promise.
lines.style: Gentle motherly advice, smiling warmly with rising encouraging intonation.
